trigger: A complete gate transfers to another agent/chat or a real blocker prevents continuation.
steps: Record repository, branch, exact head, owned scope, forbidden scope, and preservation state.
List only validators actually run and their outcomes.
Name the current runtime backend and whether live crew execution was actually observed.
Record generated report and route-decision artifact paths when present.
Provide one exact next command that verifies the pinned head in an isolated worktree before execution.
failure_handling: Never claim live First Mate, Herdr, PR, merge, or deployment proof from static harness validation.
proof_ceiling: workflow-state evidence only unless the owning runtime/validator produces stronger proof
